name: frame
description: Apply an explicit, named frame that adds substantive reasoning checks without a fixed output worksheet — either to a problem (for the agent's own understanding) or to an answer you already have (for the user's). Two reasoning lenses take a problem APART: first-principles (decompose DOWN — strip to irreducible axioms, rebuild from them, surface where that diverges from convention), and orthogonal (decompose SIDEWAYS — factor a tangled phenomenon into mutually-independent axes, verify the independence, name what was conflated). Two delivery members face the other direction: draw (choose the useful visual form and medium), and analogize (DELIVER — build a deliberately stress-tested analogy for a concept already understood, generate multiple candidates, check the mapping, name where it breaks). Each reasons or explains in-chat (no file artifact); the two lenses feed one-way into shape (an insight → a thought / mockup / plan), analogize does not (nothing left to converge). Standalone — no nav/shape dependency. Renamed from think.
